notes: §2002:14.8.17.3 GR4: a GOBACK in a method acts as EXIT METHOD with its RAISING phrase, so the method ends at the GOBACK and returns its RETURNING value (§2002:14.8.13.3 GR7), and RAISING EC-SIZE-OVERFLOW raises the condition in the invoker, whose USE runs and resumes (§2002:14.8.13.3 GR3a). The golden matched at --std 2002 (exit 0).
